notes: Tuition: the DAAD page states the non-EU fee (1,500 EUR) on this programme's own page, and the university pages confirm it for newly enrolled international students not from EU/EEA countries; it is a per-semester fee, not per year. Application channel: the programme is admission-free with direct enrolment via the university's eCampus portal, but foreign-diploma applicants must first obtain recognition through Studienkolleg Konstanz or uni-assist; the university's own portal (eCampus) is the application route for programmes with direct enrolment, so the VPD path is stated here with de-uni-assist-vpd. Intakes: the university says the programme only starts in the winter semester; the Studienkolleg Konstanz deadline for the winter semester is June 1, quoted as 2026-06-01; the main university application period usually ends on July 15 (no year stated), and the DAAD page says direct-enrolment programmes remain open until 20 September. Evidence for German proficiency: none required. The IBIS module handbook PDF belongs to the International Business - Intercultural Studies programme and was not used for this programme. Documents: the bachelor application page names certificate recognition and a school-leaving certificate quote; no explicit translation requirement was found for this programme, so translationRequired is null.

evidence.quote: If you hold a non-German school leaving certificate, you must first have it recognized by Studienkolleg Konstanz or by Uni-Assist.
Please ensure enough time for this before the application deadline at Heilbronn University of Applied Sciences!
